Dangerous in transition and the half court, consistently turning paint touches into playmaking opportunities. Luke's ability to turn the corner makes him a drive and kick threat off ball screens and downhill attacks, using his eyes up to survey before firing pinpoint passes to cutters, rollers, shooters, and bigs diving into open space.</p> <!-- /wp:paragraph --> <!-- /wp:acf/evaluation-block --> <!-- wp:acf/evaluation-block {"name":"acf/evaluation-block","data":{"player_evaluations_0_player":["2767928"],"_player_evaluations_0_player":"field_62ab9d62ecf2c","player_evaluations_0_override_profile_image":"","_player_evaluations_0_override_profile_image":"override-player-profile-image","player_evaluations_0_not_in_database":"","_player_evaluations_0_not_in_database":"field_62aba48cecf2d","player_evaluations":1,"_player_evaluations":"field_62aba7547dc44"},"mode":"preview","alignText":"left","anchor":"acf-block-6a9e43aa8a47d"} --> <!-- wp:paragraph {"placeholder":"Add evaluation here...","className":"text-gray-700"} --> <p class="text-gray-700">[player_tooltip player_id='2767928' first='Chris' last='Martinez'], a true floor general, stood out as one of the highest assist leaders on the EYBL circuit this past summer, finishing top-5 overall after leading [program_tooltip program_id='2371255' first='AB' last='Elite'] with 6 assists per game. Martinez also generated multiple double-digit assist performances, consistently setting teammates up with easy points, making the game and everyone around him better with his ability to create.</p> <!-- /wp:paragraph --> <!-- /wp:acf/evaluation-block --> <!-- wp:acf/evaluation-block {"name":"acf/evaluation-block","data":{"player_evaluations_0_player":["2823944"],"_player_evaluations_0_player":"field_62ab9d62ecf2c","player_evaluations_0_override_profile_image":"","_player_evaluations_0_override_profile_image":"override-player-profile-image","player_evaluations_0_not_in_database":"","_player_evaluations_0_not_in_database":"field_62aba48cecf2d","player_evaluations":1,"_player_evaluations":"field_62aba7547dc44"},"mode":"preview","alignText":"left","anchor":"acf-block-6a9e43aa8a4e8"} --> <!-- wp:paragraph {"placeholder":"Add evaluation here...","className":"text-gray-700"} --> <p class="text-gray-700">[player_tooltip player_id='2823944' first='Romeo' last='Harrison'] has an impressive difficulty of passing, built around seeing plays develop ahead of time before the defense closes the passing window. Smart and masterful skillset to manipulate defenders with his eyes, pace, and positioning before firing one-handed lasers, hit-ahead passes, pocket deliveries, and cross-court skips often throwing teammates open directly into their next spot. Harrison can also dissect a defense with simple dimes as well, threading traffic with bounce passes, hitting his roller with precision and timing in pick-and-roll coverage.</p> <!-- /wp:paragraph --> <!-- /wp:acf/evaluation-block --> <!-- wp:acf/evaluation-block {"name":"acf/evaluation-block","data":{"player_evaluations_0_player":["2984182"],"_player_evaluations_0_player":"field_62ab9d62ecf2c","player_evaluations_0_override_profile_image":"","_player_evaluations_0_override_profile_image":"override-player-profile-image","player_evaluations_0_not_in_database":"","_player_evaluations_0_not_in_database":"field_62aba48cecf2d","player_evaluations":1,"_player_evaluations":"field_62aba7547dc44"},"mode":"preview","alignText":"left","anchor":"acf-block-6a9e43aa8a546"} --> <!-- wp:paragraph {"placeholder":"Add evaluation here...","className":"text-gray-700"} --> <p class="text-gray-700">[player_tooltip player_id='2984182' first='Nico' last='Cajas'] showcases craftiness and creativity with the ball that is on another level. True dime dropper who has the ball on a string while scanning the court and delivering passes in rhythm, showing a natural ability to change passing angles with subtle wrist, body, and ball movements, using one-handed deliveries, push passes, wraparounds, and live-dribble reads to hit teammates in stride before the defense could recover.</p> <!-- /wp:paragraph --> <!-- /wp:acf/evaluation-block --> <!-- wp:acf/evaluation-block {"name":"acf/evaluation-block","data":{"player_evaluations_0_player":["3347632"],"_player_evaluations_0_player":"field_62ab9d62ecf2c","player_evaluations_0_override_profile_image":"","_player_evaluations_0_override_profile_image":"override-player-profile-image","player_evaluations_0_not_in_database":"","_player_evaluations_0_not_in_database":"field_62aba48cecf2d","player_evaluations":1,"_player_evaluations":"field_62aba7547dc44"},"mode":"preview","alignText":"left","anchor":"acf-block-6a9e43aa8a5a9"} --> <!-- wp:paragraph {"placeholder":"Add evaluation here...","className":"text-gray-700"} --> <p class="text-gray-700">[player_tooltip player_id='3347632' first='Dominyk' last='De La Rosa'] is as dangerous of a shot creator as they come, using a low tight shifty handle and footwork that allows him to touch the paint and play-make for others at will. He excels zipping passes to cutters and duck-ins off a live dribble showing the ability to read and react as the defense collapses.</p> <!-- /wp:paragraph --> <!-- /wp:acf/evaluation-block --> <!-- wp:acf/evaluation-block {"name":"acf/evaluation-block","data":{"player_evaluations_0_player":["3346662"],"_player_evaluations_0_player":"field_62ab9d62ecf2c","player_evaluations_0_override_profile_image":"","_player_evaluations_0_override_profile_image":"override-player-profile-image","player_evaluations_0_not_in_database":"","_player_evaluations_0_not_in_database":"field_62aba48cecf2d","player_evaluations":1,"_player_evaluations":"field_62aba7547dc44"},"mode":"preview","alignText":"left","anchor":"acf-block-6a9e43aa8a600"} --> <!-- wp:paragraph {"placeholder":"Add evaluation here...","className":"text-gray-700"} --> <p class="text-gray-700">[player_tooltip player_id='3346662' first='Dominic' last='Walker'] plays with blistering quickness and constant forward momentum, keeping the ball tight while shifting gears and changing direction to get where he pleases on the court. Walker's facilitating is built around his quickness that collapses the defense, before firing accurate passes the moment help committed. What separates Walker is his decision-making at full speed, rarely wasting a dribble and consistently making the correct read between attacking the rim, pulling up, or delivering the ball to the open man.</p> <!-- /wp:paragraph --> <!-- /wp:acf/evaluation-block -->
